accepted.description: Value accepted after deterministic validation with no retained caveat.

accepted_with_caveat.description: Value accepted but a checkpoint or extraction caveat must be retained.

component_only.description: Evidence identifies a component only and not the requested attribute value.

dictionary_value_not_supported.description: Approved evidence does not contain a supported dictionary value.

evidence_containment_failed.description: Value or quote cannot be strictly contained in the approved evidence bundle.

insufficient_attribute_evidence.description: Approved evidence does not clearly support the requested attribute.

response_schema_invalid.description: Provider response has a structurally invalid schema value.

wrong_event.description: Evidence belongs to a different requested event.

wrong_system.description: Evidence belongs to a different system.
